files.header: Onyx Elm shell — abyssal monochrome + single sea-glass accent. System stack, 6px radii, hierarchy via weight/size. No gradients.

elm polish/pol-stats — public /stats, /status and /roadmap pages. Ported from src/routes/{stats,status,roadmap,public-room-comparison, data-pages,landing}.css and re-cut to the Elm language: near-black surfaces, warm off-white text, 1px seams, 6px radii, no gradients or glow. The accent marks one thing here: the live/current answer (fresh feed pip, selected control, primary action, focus). Every rule is scoped to a page root so the shared `r-*` / `data-*` names cannot leak into other public pages.

v3 polish / pol-studio — the /appearance page and the Theme Studio (View.Appearance, View.Studio). Ported from src/app/appearance.css, src/backgrounds/picker/background-picker.css and the STUDIO_CSS block in src/theme/ThemeStudio.tsx, re-cut for the Elm language: near-black steps (bg / panel / panel-2) split by the 1px seam, warm off-white text, 6px radii, hierarchy by weight and size, no gradients or glow. The accent marks only the current location (bar tag), primary actions (apply / generate / bake / save) and focus. Selection is neutral: panel-2 ground + a text-coloured hairline.  The live preview mock (.ts-pv-*) deliberately paints from the THEME tokens (--ink / --stone / --paper / --lap

v3/pol-shell — production polish for the shell views (inbox, account, moderation desk, browser/formation, calls hub, rail, room header, prefs, profile, topbar identity, stewardship, switcher, notify). Ported from the Solid reference (src/shell/**, src/app/*.css) onto the Elm tokens in app.css :root. One sea-glass accent: current location, primary action, focus ring, mention glyph. 6px radii, no glow.

v3/pol-thread — the core chat surface: transcript rows, dividers, intro, typing, replies, inline media / previews / file chips, the lightbox, the thread sheet, the composer (context bars, attachments, conversation picker, outbox), message search, the media index and pins. Tokens from app.css :root only. Near-black surfaces, warm off-white text; the sea-glass accent marks current location, the primary action, focus and the mention glyph — nothing else.

v3/ui-roster — the channel member list (View.Roster).  A calm list in the Discord / Slack mould: one clean line per person (avatar with a presence dot, the full name), role sections in words with counts, Away dimmed at the end, the filter folded into an icon until it is needed, no per-row buttons on touch and a single quiet Message icon on hover / focus with a fine pointer.  Wide layouts (>= 1100px) show the list in flow as the 240px context rail. Below that the frame hides the rail and the room header's people toggle opens the same element as a popover sheet: a right side sheet on tablets, a full-height bottom sheet on phones. The browser owns open / close, light dismiss and Escape (popover

v3/pol-public — the public website (frame, landing, about, download, guides, invite, OnyxOS, info/trust pages, 404).  Same design language as the app shell: near-black ground, warm off-white text, ONE sea-glass accent (primary action, current location, focus), 6px radii, hierarchy by weight and size. No gradients, glow, or glass. Decorative Solid scene layers (r-ground/r-flecks/r-veins/r-grain/onyxos-grid/public-atmosphere) are intentionally not drawn. Breakpoint 768px; phone-safe at 375px.

v3/calls-c8 — calls C8 + C9 (CALLS_DESIGN.md §2.4, §2.10, §2.11, §3.4, §2.18): Hand / React / Captions in the bar, the React menu, reaction chips, the live captions plate, the push-to-talk hint and the Voice settings sheet. Tokens only from app.css :root. The accent keeps its one call meaning (live audio now) — nothing here uses it except the shared focus ring.

v3/calls-c11 — C11 stage mode (spec §2.16, oracle StagePanel) and the C12 accessibility pass over every call surface (spec §3.2–3.4, §6). Tokens come from app.css :root. Accent stays reserved for the live pip, the speaking ring and the focus ring; a raised hand is warn.

v3/polish — composer More tools tray, time scrubber, the quiet first-run notifications / Add to Home Screen sheets, and the update-available strip. Tokens only (app.css :root); the accent marks the primary action, the current hour and the focus ring.

v3/account2 — session reclaim banner, revoke-others confirm, portable residence, theme share/import sheet, You hub status block, People sheet, sidebar friend presence. Tokens come from :root in app.css.

v3/roomsettings — room header completion (privacy glyph, expandable topic, facepile, second row) and the Room settings sheet + 3.8 room surfaces (scheduled event, bridge badge, group-control mark, insights). Tokens only; accent reserved for the primary action and the focus ring.

v3/calls-c6 — DM ring dialogs (C6), mini voice view (C7) and reconnecting / error states (C10). Spec: design/calls/CALLS_DESIGN.md §2.8, §2.9, §2.14, §2.18. Tokens come from app.css :root. Accent is used only for the live pip and the speaking outline.

v3/calls-c4 — calls C4 + C5 (CALLS_DESIGN.md §2.4, §2.6, §2.7, §2.13, §2.18): camera / share / deafen controls, the connection pip and turn-off-camera prompt, the video grid, participant tiles, spotlight + screenshare layouts and stage sizes. Tokens only from app.css :root. The accent means live audio now: tile speaking border and talk bars — nothing else.

v3/ui-sheets — every overlay, sheet and popover in the shell. Loaded LAST so it wins the cascade over app.css + the pol-* files.  One family: near-black panel, 1px seam, 6px radii, the short cool sheet shadow (--elev-3), a sticky head (kicker / title / subtitle, trailing actions, icon close), and on phones a true bottom sheet — grab handle, internal scroll, safe-area padding, swipe-down to dismiss (pure CSS scroll-snap, see View.Sheet). Desktop keeps centred dialogs in three widths, right-hand side panels, and a top-right popover for the inbox.  Icons are CSS masks over data-URI SVGs (never font glyphs).

v3/ios — the shared iOS / touch plumbing for the app frame.  Loaded last so it can lay device geometry over every surface without restyling them. Reads the geometry tokens from app.css :root: --safe-top/right/bottom/left (env(safe-area-inset-*)), --vvh (visual viewport height, published by ports.js installViewportInsets; 100dvh or 100vh without it) and --kb-inset / --vv-top / <html data-kb>.  1. document feel — no tap flash, no text inflation, no double-tap zoom on controls, press states for touch, chrome not selectable; 2. the app shell — fixed to the visual viewport (so the composer rides above the on-screen keyboard), no rubber-banding, lists scroll inside themselves; 3. safe areas — top

v3/calls-engine — call surface polish once real calls run (elm/media voice engine). Loaded last; overrides only call classes.  - The bar reflows by the STAGE's width (container queries), not the viewport: the stage lives in the message column, whose width depends on the rails. Wide: info | controls | chip. Narrow: info + chip on one row, every control on one even row of >= 44px targets. - Person cells top-align (a role line no longer pushes a neighbour down). - Phone: the More menu is a bottom sheet; an expanded/fullscreen stage is a full-screen call screen sized by 100dvh with safe-area insets (iOS Safari, installed PWA); the docked bar drops the bottom inset it only needs at the screen edg
